notes: Sourced from the official CueScript CSM17-19-22 V2 Prompter Installation and Operation Manual (covers CSMV217/CSMV219/CSMV222, same connector panel design, only screen size/dimensions differ) plus the CSMV222 product page at cuescript.tv/product-profile.php?pid=CSMV222. This is an on-camera/desktop teleprompter monitor (21.3" 1600x1200 UXGA panel), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted; "Display" was chosen as the closest type since "Teleprompter" is not in the enum. SDI grade is sdi-3g (spec states SD/HD/3G-SDI per SMPTE 259M-C/292M/424M). HDMI grade is hdmi-1.4 (spec states compatible with HDMI 1.3/1.4/1.4a). Ethernet port speed is not stated in any source, so no grade was set. USB A/B connector versions are also not stated. The rear-panel photo in the manual is labeled for the 19" variant (CSM V2-19) but the manual explicitly states the connector layout/spec applies to all three V2 models including the 222. Power draw: 41VA AC max / 46W DC max (with CSCN clock + CSTD accessories connected); rises to 85VA AC when a CSTM22 companion talent monitor is also connected.

ports.name: DC OUT
ports.note: 4-pin XLR female accessory power out, 12VDC @4A max, only live when unit is AC-powered

ports.name: SWITCHED SDI OUT
ports.note: Auxiliary switched SDI output; source selectable among Prompt SDI/Talent SDI/SFP feeds

ports.name: PROMPT CVBS IN
ports.note: Composite video (PAL/NTSC/SECAM), analog - no bandwidth grade

ports.name: SFP+ IP VIDEO
ports.note: Optional SMPTE ST2110 IP video input, requires license + compatible SFP module; no bandwidth grade in defined scale

ports.name: USB A 1
ports.note: Multipurpose: CueTALK relay for scroll controller, USB keyboard for network config, or USB mass storage for debug logging

ports.name: USB A 2
ports.note: Multipurpose: CueTALK relay for scroll controller, USB keyboard for network config, or USB mass storage for debug logging

ports.name: TALLY SENSOR
ports.note: Physically a USB Mini-B socket (closest available id in the connector list, not USB data) used for CueScript CueLight optical/tally sensor input

ports.name: LTC IN
ports.note: Physically a 3-pin mini-XLR (Neutrik RT3FC-B mating plug), not full-size XLR3; balanced/unbalanced LTC timecode input
